A line break written as `
` in a table cell, which is the only way a cell holds two lines, is the break it is in both packages rather than the characters.

A line of a table cell written as a list item is drawn with the marker a list would have, and nested by the spaces in front of it. A cell holds no list, so the parser reads words; the drawing is the renderer's.
